cards.text: Friend, God gives His prophet Jeremiah a message for His people, and it opens with two questions. When people fall, don't they get up again? When someone turns away, don't they come back?

cards.question: God asks why Jerusalem always turns away. True or false: He says the people refuse to return.
God says the people of Jerusalem are holding on tight to something. What do they cling to?

cards.text: God has listened, and not one person stops to ask, 'What have I done?' Nobody hits the brakes, nobody checks the map, NOBODY.

cards.question: Everyone in Jerusalem keeps pursuing his own course. What does God say they're like?

cards.text: Then God points to the sky, where the stork, the turtledove, the swift and the thrush all keep their time of migration. Friend, those birds have a better calendar than me, and I spent years in a junk drawer not knowing if it was Tuesday or Christmas.

cards.question: True or false: God says His people know His requirements as well as the stork knows her seasons.

cards.text: The people have a comeback: 'We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,' and God asks how they can even say that.

cards.question: The people claim the Law of the LORD is with them, but God says something has produced a deception. What is it?

answers.text: The lying pen of the scribes
The old sayings of the elders
The loud songs of the singers

cards.text: God says the wise will be put to shame, dismayed and trapped, and then He asks what wisdom they really have. That's like me bragging I'm the best stamper in the kitchen while every cookie comes out BLURRY.

cards.question: God says the people who call themselves wise don't have much wisdom at all. Why?

answers.text: They rejected the word of the LORD
They never read the Law at all
They trusted the words of foreign kings

cards.text: So God says He'll give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, everybody is greedy for gain.

cards.question: God says the people's leaders are no better: from prophet to ___, all practice deceit.

cards.text: God's people are hurting, and the prophets and priests treat it like a paper cut. That's me back in the Millers' kitchen swearing my edges were FINE, friend, when my edges were GONE.

cards.question: The prophets and priests dress the ___ of God's people with very little care, saying ___ when there is none at all.
God asks if the people are ashamed of the abomination they've committed. True or false: they blush with shame over it.

cards.text: So God says they will fall among the fallen. There's that word fall again, friend, and this time, when He punishes them, they collapse.
Then God says He'll take away their harvest. No grapes on the vine, no figs on the tree.

cards.question: God says even the ___ will wither, and whatever He gave them will be lost to them.

cards.text: Now the voice changes, and it's the people talking: 'Why are we just sitting here?' They say the LORD their God has doomed them, and it's time to gather together and flee.

cards.question: The people say, gather together and let's flee. Where do they say they'll go?
The people say the LORD has given them poisoned water to drink. True or false: they say it's because they have sinned against the LORD.

cards.text: They hoped for peace and for a time of healing. I know that kind of hope, friend, from all those years holding my breath in the junk drawer every time it opened.

cards.question: The people hoped for peace and a time of healing. What came instead?

cards.text: Then the enemy comes to devour the land and everything in it, the city and everyone who lives there. And you hear them before you see them.

cards.question: A sound is heard from Dan, and the whole land quakes. What is it?

answers.text: War trumpets blasting from the hills
Hungry lions roaring in the night

cards.text: And God gets the last word: He's sending snakes among them. Not the kind anybody can sweet-talk, either.

cards.question: God says the vipers He sends cannot be ___, and they will bite.

findings.problem: The right answer stands out from the other two. The two wrong answers share the same shape ('Their idols', 'Their kings'), and the right answer is the only one that breaks the pattern ('Deceit'), so a baker can spot it by its form.

rule.text: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.

findings.problem: The joke adds a new event to Papa Dorin's backstory: him 'swearing my edges were FINE' in the Millers' kitchen. The backstory never has him doing this. It says Mother Miller never complained and just pressed harder.

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: The comparison doesn't share the verse's core action. In 8:11, people treat someone else's wound carelessly and promise peace that isn't there. In the joke, Papa Dorin denies his own wear. Those are different actions.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the next word of the line ('even the ___ will wither'). Nothing on the earlier cards lets a baker reason out 'leaf' over 'root', so it tests wording they haven't seen, not meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'well' isn't the same kind of thing as 'leaf' and 'root'. A well is not part of a plant and can't wither, so it is easy to rule out.

rule.text: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly.

findings.problem: This setup card says 'the enemy comes' and that 'you hear them'. That rules out 'Hungry lions roaring in the night' on card 13, which is not the enemy. It also matches the right answer, the only one that starts with 'Enemy'.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
